items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: They had a band called the California Ramblers, a big white band, and the drummer was Stanley somebody.

ctx.x: Bechet and Tricky and Bubba, every night was a jam session. We play our stuff, but then for an added attraction all them musicians was coming and hang out there. Bechet would take napkin off the table and put it in his teeth and hide his hands under the keys and drive you crazy and Tricky would take a plunger, he had an old tomato can all bent up. He'd make it sound like a bass, drive you crazy. Bubba take two notes, set you wild. That was the highlight of the thing. Play anything.

But them cats were jamming and them ofays couldn't get over it. A guy, a trumpet player come up to Bubba and offered him $25.00 for his mouthpiece. "Bubba how you...?" man, it's the mouthpiece." Say "would you sell it!" "I don't know." I give you $25.00 for it. Only for you." The mouthpiece ain't cost but two or three dollars.
